findings.problem: The only specified failure test uses a supervisor program that starts successfully but emits no `ready`. It does not exercise the distinct `Popen` failure path where the watchdog cannot be started at all, after the launcher already exists. A regression in that exception cleanup path could leave an unguarded launcher running while the stated completion criterion still appears covered.
findings.suggestion: Add a separate test that makes watchdog startup raise `OSError` (or uses a missing supervisor executable) and asserts both a watchdog-naming failure and that the launcher/process group is gone.

findings.problem: The proposed hand check cannot establish that the helper's 60-second stop killed the engine if the model-call limit is "short": `_run` may time out and clean up before the helper reaches its own limit.
findings.suggestion: Specify a model-call limit longer than 60 seconds, wait for watchdog readiness, and confirm the helper timed out before checking that the launcher and child are gone.

summary: The plan needs coverage of actual watchdog-start failure; its helper integration check also needs an unambiguous timeout arrangement.
